facts.business: GKB Ophthalmics Ltd. is a manufacturer of semi-finished plastic lenses.

capacity_or_capex.item: Capital advance for contracts on capital account

guidance_or_targets.statement: With tariffs returning to normal levels, the Company expects to steadily achieve its sales targets for the 2026-27 financial year.

key_risks: Economic situation in exporting countries affecting performance
High tariffs imposed by US government impacting exports to subsidiary Lensco in USA
Aggressive pricing and dumping by Chinese manufacturers in Indian market
Reduced market share and lower sales realization
facts.related_party_note: All transactions entered into with related parties during the year were at arm's length basis. Details of contracts/arrangements/transactions required to be reported in Form AOC-2 are enclosed as Annexure I. The Company has formulated a policy on materiality of related party transactions and dealing with them, approved by the Board and uploaded on the company's website.
